title: IP Services Overview: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A hotel has a front desk, a concierge and a switchboard. Together they make a guest's stay smooth. D H C P, N A T and D N S do the same for a network.

scenes.heading: The hotel
scenes.narration: Three services quietly do most of the work. The front desk hands out a room number, which is D H C P. The switchboard presents one public number to the outside, which is N A T. The concierge turns names into room numbers, which is D N S. And a relay carries requests across buildings, which is the helper address.

scenes.heading: DHCP in four steps
scenes.narration: D H C P follows the word D O R A. Discover. Offer. Request. Acknowledge.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. N A T isn't a firewall. D H C P gives a whole configuration. And D N S resolves internal names as well.

items.right: It resolves any internal name too

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva IP services lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. D H C P assigns, N A T translates and D N S names. Remember D O R A. N A T is not a firewall. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva IP services lab.
